findings.title: Diff is evidence-only, no application code
findings.detail: The visible diff only updates coverage ratchet state, live API evidence snapshots, measurement-meta timestamps, and a score-history/verdict dump. No application source (routes, components, workers, migrations) appears in the provided hunks, so no product fix can be verified from this commit.

findings.title: Gate still failing ship and bindings
findings.detail: Recorded verdicts include lg-shipped passed:false, lg-bindings-bound passed:false, deployUrl:null, and provenance.dirty:true on commit 181e085. That is explicit proof the app is not shipped and bindings are not verified; a score/evidence refresh does not clear those blockers.

findings.title: API and measurement rules still fail
findings.detail: u-api-not-found, u-api-no-spa-mask, fe-light-dark, meas-known-bad, meas-two-run, meas-standard-tool, and meas-engine-named are all recorded passed:false with a long blocker list on iteration 1. The commit only re-stamps evidence timestamps and response bodies; it does not show fixes for those failures.

findings.title: Live API evidence still truncated and queued-only
findings.detail: GET /api jobs responseBody remains truncated mid-field (ends at "thresho") and lists many identical bird-watching jobs still status queued. That does not prove healthy job completion or complete API contract coverage; it is a re-capture of the same partial snapshot shape.

findings.title: Coverage baseCommit moved without code proof
findings.detail: baseCommit changes from 2adaa95… to 5b4c7df… while highWaterPct stays 94.37. Without a source or test diff, this looks like ratchet bookkeeping on a new base, not a verified coverage improvement.

findings.title: Cannot verify middle of truncated diff
findings.detail: The prompt marks the middle of the unified diff as truncated. Any claims about unshown files cannot be verified from the supplied text; only the evidence/meta and score-history patterns that appear are reviewable, and those show re-runs of measurements (including fe-search-present ok:false twice) rather than product changes.
